mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board (member_id, title, content, created_at) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{title}, #{content}, NOW());
mapper.select: SELECT b.board_id, b.title, b.content, m.nickname FROM board b JOIN member m ON b.member_id = m.member_id WHERE b.member_id = #{memberId};
